verses.text: ¶ The Elder vnto the elect Lady, and her children, whome I loue in the trueth: and not I onely, but alſo all they that haue knowen yͤ trueth:
For the trueths ſake which dwelleth in vs, and ſhalbe with vs for euer:
Grace bee with you, mercie, and peace from God the Father, and from the Lord Ieſus Chriſt, the Sonne of the Father in trueth and loue.
I reioyced greatly, that I found of thy children walking in trueth, as wee haue receiued a commaundement from the Father.
And now, I beſeech thee Lady, not as though I wrote a new commandement vnto thee: but that which wee had from the beginning, that wee loue one another.
And this is loue, that wee walke after his Commandements. This is the Commandement, that as yee haue heard from the beginning, yee ſhould walke in it.
For many deceiuers are entred into the world, who confeſſe not that Ieſus Chriſt is come in the fleſh. This is a deceiuer, and an Antichriſt.
Looke to your ſelues, that wee loſe not thoſe things which wee haue wrought, but that we receiue a full reward.
Whoſoeuer tranſgreſſeth and abideth not in the doctrine of Chriſt, hath not God: hee that abideth in the doctrine of Chriſt, he hath both the Father and the Sonne.
If there come any vnto you, and bring not this doctrine, receiue him not into your houſe, neither bid him, God ſpeed.
For hee that biddeth him God ſpeed, is partaker of his euill deeds.
Hauing many things to write vnto you, I would not write with paper and inke, but I truſt to come vnto you, and ſpeake face to face, that our ioy may be full.
The children of thy elect ſiſter greet thee. Amen.
